Founder & Architect, 2025 to Present

Architect and build an agentic decision-intelligence platform end to end on Claude, with a front-end product surface where users pose questions, see how a result was reached, and interrogate the reasoning: on Next.js / TypeScript / Tailwind / Prisma.
